title: Quiet-window microshims and canary ledger (preflight)
content:
Purpose:
This note collects a compact, usable preflight for small quiet-window releases that rely on microshims (tiny config/route adjustments) and a lightweight canary ledger for multi-lane observation. Intention is to have an operator-readable checklist + week-by-week ops docket and a draft of release notes to hand to product and CS once tags are frozen.

Context / constraints:
- Target release: microfeature rollouts that must not disturb global latency SLOs (99p latency < 150ms).
- Quiet window: 02:00–05:00 PT local window chosen for low traffic across NA/EU (check traffic heatmap before flip).
- Microshims: short-lived config changes (timeouts, batching caps, route weights, KV cache TTL nudges).
- Canary ledger: single-line audit of which cohort (region, route) saw which variant and when.

Operator TL;DR checklist (do this in order, tick in shift binder):
1) Prefreezing
   - Confirm merged PRs and pinned model commits (runtime + model manifest).
   - Verify canary config exists in infra repo (path: infra/canary/<release-id>).
   - Upload smoke prompt set to /tmp/smoke-prompts/<release-id> and note size (~120 prompts).
   - Notify SRE on #release-ops channel 48h and again 3h before.

2) Preflight (T-6h to T-1h)\   - Snapshot baseline latency & error-rate for affected routes (export to release bucket).\   - Run synthetic traffic with 10x normal token mix against stage canary (5m run).\   - Confirm staging KV cache warmup plan: seeds + sample prefixes.
   - Validate rollback artifact exists and is tested (hotfix branch build id).

3) Quiet-window execution (02:00–05:00 PT)\   - 02:00: Switch route weight to canary lane (1%). Record ledger entry: "02:00 UTC-8: canary v1 -> 1%".\   - 02:10: Run smoke suite (smoke-prompts quick-run, latency + correctness checks).\   - 02:30: If pass, bump to 5%. Record ledger entry.\   - 03:00: Full sampling telemetry (token-level latency hist, error traces).\   - 03:30: If stable, bump to 20% and continue monitoring.\   - 04:30: If stable and no KPIs tripped, bump to 50% (final day-of decision).\   - 04:55: Freeze canary and emit release note draft to product/CS.

4) Rollback triggers (immediate action)\   - Sustained 5m P95 latency increase >20% vs baseline.
   - Error-rate spike >0.5% absolute or >3x baseline.
   - New OOM / GPU abort events in the runtime logs.
   - Any data-exfil/log anomaly flagged by security.

Canary ledger (minimal rows — operator appends one-line entries):
- Schema (freeform): timestamp | lane | variant | weight | operator | quick-note
- Example entries:
  - 2024-02-03T02:00Z | us-west | runtime-v3-canary | 1% | Marcus.N | smoke-run queued
  - 2024-02-03T02:12Z | us-west | runtime-v3-canary | 5% | Hannah.L | smoke pass, latency nominal
  - 2024-02-03T03:45Z | eu-central | runtime-v3 | 20% | Diego.R | sampling healthy

Weekly ops docket (compact view — copy to calendar invites):
- Mon (T-5): preflight rehearsal (30m) — staging smoke + telemetry sanity check. Owner: Aisha.
- Wed (T-3): Conformance review (20m) — security + compliance signoff. Owner: Security team.
- Fri (T-2): Canary config freeze + artifact signing (15m). Owner: Release engineer on-call.
- Sun (T-1): Final smoke run (15m) + shift handover notes written. Owner: night lead.
- Mon (deployment day): Quiet window ops (02:00–05:00 PT). Owners: release conductor + SRE on duty.

Staffing rotation snippet (example for night shift ops):
- Primary conductor: Marcus Nguyen (02:00–06:00)
- Secondary conductor: Hannah Lee (02:00–06:00)
- SRE on-call: Diego Ramos (shadow + infra rollback)
- Telemetry analyst: Elisa (dash sampling + alert triage)
- Product contact: Aisha (standby for release notes)

Smoke suite (brief):
- Latency smoke: 30 short prompts (avg token length ~25) measure 99p, 95p, mean.
- Correctness smoke: 20 structured prompts with golden answers; quick diffs.
- Token cost smoke: measure per-request token counts for cost anomaly detection.
- Model behavior smoke: 10 prompts exercising new prompt templates/edge cases.

Observability hooks to validate before go/no-go:
- Traces: open tracing must include model-id, kernel selection tag, batching size.
- Metrics: route.p95_ms, route.error_rate, gpu_mem_free, kv_cache_hit_ratio.
- Logs: capture runtime WARN/ERROR with stack snippet url in ledger.

Release notes (draft — send to product & CS after freeze):
- Title: runtime v3 microshim rollout (2024-02-03)\- Summary: Small runtime tuning and route setup to improve cold-start tail latency for short-context requests. No model weights changed.\- Key changes:
  - Adjusted request batching cap on low-latency routes (cap from 32 -> 24) to reduce tail.
  - KV cache TTL extended for short prefixes (helps short-session reuse).
  - Minor kernel selector tweak to prefer fp16 paths for small sequences in GPU T4 instances.
- Impact: Expected 5–12% reduction in 99p for short-requests on affected routes. No disruption expected; rollback plan in place.
- Notes for integrators: If you see increased token counts or slightly higher average latency for long-form generation, please file a ticket with samples flagged.

Unresolved Qs / TODOs (notes to self):
- Q: Does kv-cache TTL change interact with Dedicated autoscaler warmup? Need brief from infra.
- Q: Are canary ledger entries replicated to ops-s3 for audit? If not, add quick push script.
- TODO: Add small rbac check that prevents canary weight flips >20% from UI without 2FA confirm.
- TODO: Run one chaos test on rollback path in staging (simulate a GPU abort mid-bump).

Appendix: quick commands and locations (operator cheat):
- Staging smoke runner: infra/tools/smoke-runner --set release-id=2024-02-03 --prompts /tmp/smoke-prompts/<id>
- Canary config: git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra.git//canary/<release-id>
- Ledger: /var/ops/release-ledgers/<release-id>.log (append-only)
- Rollback: infra/scripts/flip-route-weight.sh --route <name> --weight 0 --revert-from <artifact>

Quick signoffs (check with initials in binder):
- Security review done: __ (name)
- SRE capacity sanity: __ (name)
- Product ack of release note: __ (name)

Notes-style: intentionally terse. Keep ledger one-line per action. If anything gets fuzzy during the quiet window, prefer immediate rollback and a short postmortem rather than lingering partial flips.

-- end of preflight doc (keep this file as the one-page conductor guide; expand into full playbook in confluence when stable)
